## 🌡️ MARKET OVERVIEW

1. What is the prevailing Global Risk Regime?
NEUTRAL, as specified by the data. Breadth: 3/11 sectors positive, a Sector Weakness reading; Leadership: Broad (4 sectors in Top 5), but technology and financials are weak and major-stock trends diverge.

2. Which sectors are leading?
Consumer Discretionary leads: TJX (1W: +10.79% | 1M: +0.46%) ABOVE TREND and LOW (1W: +4.80% | 1M: +16.56%) ABOVE TREND. Communication is strong with TTWO (1W: +8.08% | 1M: +8.39%) ABOVE TREND; Consumer Staples gains, with TGT (1W: +10.36% | 1M: +19.37%) ABOVE TREND.

3. Which sectors are lagging?
Energy is weakest: MPC (1W: -9.97% | 1M: -24.33%) and VLO (1W: -10.42% | 1M: -23.64%) are BELOW TREND. Materials and Technology also lag, with FCX (1W: -13.69% | 1M: -26.75%) and AVGO (1W: -11.86% | 1M: -8.53%) BELOW TREND.

## 📈 STOCK PERFORMANCE

4. Top Performing Stocks?
Top 5: PANW (1W: +14.13% | 1M: -9.60%) RECOVERY; TJX (1W: +10.79% | 1M: +0.46%) ABOVE TREND; TGT (1W: +10.36% | 1M: +19.37%) ABOVE TREND; TTWO (1W: +8.08% | 1M: +8.39%) ABOVE TREND; F (1W: +5.38% | 1M: +4.45%) ABOVE TREND. Leadership: Broad (4 sectors in Top 5); PANW’s rebound remains a divergence, not confirmed trend strength.

5. Worst Performing Stocks?
Bottom 5: CEG (1W: -8.67% | 1M: -2.88%), MPC (1W: -9.97% | 1M: -24.33%), NEM (1W: -10.40% | 1M: -9.69%), VLO (1W: -10.42% | 1M: -23.64%) and AVGO (1W: -11.86% | 1M: -8.53%) are all BELOW TREND. Weakness spans Utilities, Energy, Materials and Technology.

6. Momentum Stocks?
Strongest 1W moves include PANW (1W: +14.13% | 1M: -9.60%) RECOVERY, TJX (1W: +10.79% | 1M: +0.46%) ABOVE TREND and TGT (1W: +10.36% | 1M: +19.37%) ABOVE TREND. Major divergence is present: AMZN (1W: -2.17% | 1M: +1.28%) and TSLA (1W: +1.20% | 1M: -1.77%) have opposing weekly and monthly signals; watch for trend breaks.

## 🏭 SECTOR OUTLOOK

7. Technology Outlook?
Technology is BELOW TREND at the sector level (1W: -3.37% | 1M: -15.55%). MSFT (1W: -1.81% | 1M: -6.67%), NVDA (1W: -0.05% | 1M: -28.06%) and GOOGL (1W: -0.41% | 1M: -11.92%) are BELOW TREND; constituent breadth counts were not provided.

8. Financials Outlook?
Financials are BELOW TREND at the sector level (1W: -2.36% | 1M: -1.74%). JPM (1W: -3.90% | 1M: -5.07%) is BELOW TREND, while MA (1W: +0.26% | 1M: +5.53%) is ABOVE TREND; constituent breadth counts were not provided.

9. Healthcare Outlook?
Healthcare is in CORRECTION at the sector level (1W: -0.62% | 1M: +0.69%). UNH (1W: -12.27% | 1M: -16.76%) is BELOW TREND, while GILD (1W: +4.72% | 1M: +12.35%) is ABOVE TREND; constituent breadth counts were not provided.

## 🧭 PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

10. Portfolio Recommendation?
Stay selective in this NEUTRAL regime: favor relative strength in Consumer Discretionary and Communication, while reducing exposure to persistent weakness in Technology and Energy. Style is mixed / no clear leadership; major divergence makes tactical opportunities—not core-position conviction—the more appropriate frame.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

11. Stocks to Watch Next Week?
BULLISH: TTWO (1W: +8.08% | 1M: +8.39%) ABOVE TREND and TGT (1W: +10.36% | 1M: +19.37%) ABOVE TREND, if momentum holds; PANW (1W: +14.13% | 1M: -9.60%) RECOVERY needs follow-through. BEARISH: AMD (1W: -17.91% | 1M: -22.21%) and AVGO (1W: -11.86% | 1M: -8.53%) are BELOW TREND; monitor for further technology weakness.

12. Sectors to Watch Next Week?
BULLISH: Consumer Discretionary (1W: +1.60% | 1M: +4.39%), Communication (1W: +1.48% | 1M: +9.26%) and Consumer Staples (1W: +0.45% | 1M: +4.23%) are ABOVE TREND at the sector level. BEARISH: Energy (1W: -5.67% | 1M: -14.56%) and Technology (1W: -3.37% | 1M: -15.55%) are BELOW TREND; overall breadth remains 3/11 positive.

13. Key Levels & Triggers?
Price levels were not supplied, so monitor return-based triggers rather than inferred support or resistance: NVDA (1W: -0.05% | 1M: -28.06%) BELOW TREND needs sustained recovery; PANW (1W: +14.13% | 1M: -9.60%) RECOVERY needs follow-through. JPM (1W: -3.90% | 1M: -5.07%) BELOW TREND and TGT (1W: +10.36% | 1M: +19.37%) ABOVE TREND are respective weakness and momentum checkpoints.

## 📰 NEWS SENTIMENT MOVERS

14. Bullish Sentiment Stocks?
BA (+60): Malaysia Aviation Group ordered 10 Boeing 787s; BA (1W: -0.20% | 1M: -13.13%) is BELOW TREND, so price action diverges from the positive catalyst. TTWO (+45): retained on Wedbush’s Best Ideas List; TTWO (1W: +8.08% | 1M: +8.39%) ABOVE TREND confirms the positive signal; GILD (+45): analyst initiation coincides with GILD (1W: +4.72% | 1M: +12.35%) ABOVE TREND, also confirming.

15. Bearish Sentiment Stocks?
AVGO (-25): reported portfolio stake sale adds to pressure; AVGO (1W: -11.86% | 1M: -8.53%) BELOW TREND confirms weakness. JPM (-30): unresolved outage concerns accompany JPM (1W: -3.90% | 1M: -5.07%) BELOW TREND; TSLA (-30): delayed EU FSD approval meeting contrasts with TSLA (1W: +1.20% | 1M: -1.77%) RECOVERY, a divergence to monitor.

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

NEUTRAL regime; breadth is 3/11 sectors positive, with Sector Weakness and Leadership: Broad (4 sectors in Top 5); style is mixed / no clear leadership. Relative strength includes TGT (1W: +10.36% | 1M: +19.37%) ABOVE TREND and TTWO (1W: +8.08% | 1M: +8.39%) ABOVE TREND. Major divergence across key stocks and technology weakness warrant caution; BA (1W: -0.20% | 1M: -13.13%) BELOW TREND is not yet confirming its positive order news.
